My story

Most people call me at a turning point: a first home, a growing family, a move closer to work or parents, or selling a house they've lived in for twenty years. Those decisions deserve patience and honest information, not pressure.

I've been doing this for 10 years, licensed since 2016, and almost all of my work happens along the Yonge corridor and the communities around it. I know these streets, these buildings and what actually drives value here.

What you get working with me

  • Numbers before opinions. Every price, offer and recommendation comes with the comparable sales, carrying costs and closing costs behind it, including land transfer tax, which is very different on either side of Steeles.
  • Every side of home improvement. Repairs, renovations, upgrades: I'll help you work out what's worth doing, what it should cost and who to call, whether you're buying a fixer-upper or getting ready to sell.
  • Careful negotiation. Price matters, but so do the deposit, conditions and closing date. I negotiate all of it.
  • Investment thinking. Rental income, expenses, financing and cash flow, broken down before you commit. It's real estate analysis, not financial advice.
  • Two languages. English or Farsi, whichever you're most comfortable with, from first call to closing.

How I communicate

  • You choose the channel. Call or text me at (647) 779-7919, or email abayat327@gmail.com, in English or Farsi.
  • Regular updates. During an active search or listing, you'll hear from me at an agreed rhythm, even when there's nothing new.
  • Reasoning shown. When I suggest a price or a strategy, you'll see the comparables and the thinking behind it.
  • No pressure. The right decision matters more than a fast one.

Questions about Ali

Who is Ali Bayat?

Ali Bayat is a REALTOR® and registered salesperson with Century 21 Heritage Group Ltd., Brokerage, licensed in Ontario since 2016, serving North York, Thornhill, Richmond Hill, Vaughan and Toronto.

Does Ali Bayat speak Farsi?

Yes. Ali works with clients in both English and Farsi, including explaining offers, contracts and negotiations in Farsi.

What areas does Ali Bayat serve?

North York, Thornhill, Richmond Hill, Vaughan and Toronto, with a focus on the communities along Yonge Street.

Which brokerage is Ali Bayat with?

Century 21 Heritage Group Ltd., Brokerage, 7330 Yonge Street, Thornhill, ON L4J 7Y7.

Can Ali help with investment properties?

Yes. He helps investors evaluate income properties by looking at rental income, operating costs, financing and cash flow. This is real estate analysis, not financial, tax or legal advice.

Can Ali help with home improvements?

Yes. Ali helps clients think through repairs, renovations and upgrades: what's worth doing before buying or selling, what it should cost, and who to call.

How can I check that Ali Bayat is licensed?

Ali is registered with RECO (registration #4789920). Every Ontario agent can be looked up on RECO's public register.

How do I contact Ali Bayat?

Call or text (647) 779-7919, or email abayat327@gmail.com. Ali usually replies within one business day.
